title: Empowering Youth in the Digital Age
query: AI inclusion, youth empowerment, and access to information in the digital age
summary: The AI4IA conference highlights the importance of inclusive access to information and education for youth empowerment. However, challenges such as the digital divide, misinformation, and accessibility barriers persist.
